notes.title: Game Launch Note
notes.content: Xenture was developed by a group of 7 students taking a class at the University of Utah during the summer of 2021, apart of the Entertainment, Arts & Engineering program. For each of them this is their first real experience working in a team environment to create a videogame good enough for public release. Feedback is more than welcome. For the moment development on the game has halted despite minor bug fixes that arise due to increase in playthroughs. We hope you enjoy our game and welcome the challenge of completing it as fast as possible.
